en.title: Resonances
en.lead: Read an ion's slow oscillation frequency from its Mathieu working point, then see which external drives or field imperfections could resonate with it. The map and response spectrum follow the shared ion and RF settings above.
en.fallback: This new section is currently available in English and Chinese. English is shown for this language.
en.scope: Ideal linear quadrupole · first common stability zone · numerical Floquet frequencies
en.reference_only: This view is a four-rod linear-quadrupole reference. Select the linear RFQ geometry and four rods to interpret it as your current model; higher multipoles and the 3D Paul mapping need different equations.
en.map_note: The pale region is stable in both transverse planes. Solid lines refer to x motion; dashed lines refer to y motion. Purple lines are candidate perturbation conditions, not loss boundaries in an ideal quadrupole.
en.map_hint: Click within the map to use that a, q as the shared direct working point. This switches the shared input mode to direct a, q; voltage controls are then illustrative.
en.candidate_note: A frequency match is necessary, not sufficient. The relevant perturbation coefficient, spatial parity, RF harmonics, excitation amplitude, ion amplitude and observation time determine whether a line is active. The presets show representative highest-order sums, not a complete selection-rule calculation. An ideal quadrupole alone has no such nonlinear loss lines. The selected A₆-cancellation rod rule removes its leading A₆ term in that separate field model; the candidate overlay does not reintroduce it.
en.outside: No frequency is assigned here: both planes must lie inside their first stable band. Boundary and higher-band points are not interpreted through a folded principal exponent.
en.out_of_frame: The shared working point is outside this first-zone map window.
en.empty_lines: Some selected frequencies have no contour in this first-zone window. This is a valid result; the range is 0 < f_ex/f_RF < 1/2 for the fundamental dipole line and 0 < f_mod/f_RF < 1 for the primary parametric line.
en.invalid: Check the resonance or shared parameters.
en.fundamentals: From the equation to a resonance
en.fundamental_1: The RF field focuses one transverse direction while defocusing the other, then reverses. A stable trajectory has slow secular motion dressed by RF-period micromotion. The two fundamental solutions propagated over one RF period form a monodromy matrix M.
en.fundamental_2: For a stable first-band trajectory, det M = 1 and its eigenvalues are exp(±iπβ). Hence β = arccos(tr M / 2)/π and f_sec = β f_RF / 2. The principal arccos folds all higher bands into 0 ≤ β ≤ 1, so this atlas explicitly restricts the interpretation to the first band in both planes.
en.fundamental_3: A uniform oscillating electric field supplies an additive force: its fundamental dipole resonance is f_ex = f_sec. Modulating the focusing strength multiplies position: the primary parametric resonance is f_mod = 2 f_sec. Their growth rates and thresholds depend on amplitude, damping and time; a line alone does not predict ejection.
en.fundamental_4: A weak nonlinear term can mix motion frequencies. A candidate condition pβₓ + rβᵧ = 2k means p fₓ + r fᵧ = k f_RF. Only terms allowed by the actual electrode symmetry and time dependence can drive that combination. A frequency degeneracy such as βₓ = βᵧ does not exchange energy without a coupling term.
en.sidebands: The full ideal Floquet spectrum also contains |n ± β/2| f_RF. This map shows fundamental dipole and primary parametric conditions; it does not display every sideband or every higher-order resonance tongue.
en.spectrum_note: This calculation actually integrates two separate driven Mathieu trajectories, one with an x-directed field and one with a y-directed field. Each starts at rest at the RF null. The plotted RMS is accumulated over the complete pulse; this is an undamped finite-time response, not a steady-state Lorentzian or a loss spectrum.
en.spectrum_limit: No collisions, damping, nonlinear forces, axial confinement or aperture clipping. Responses larger than r₀ exceed the physical aperture interpretation. RF and auxiliary cosine phases start at zero. Increasing the pulse duration sharpens finite-time features; doubling a weak dipole field doubles the displacement in this linear model.
en.aperture_warning: At least one driven trajectory exceeds r₀. These are unclipped ideal-equation responses and cannot be interpreted as transmitted or trapped ions.
en.no_response: A response spectrum requires both planes to be inside their first stable band.
en.export_wait: Wait for the current calculation to finish before exporting.
en.sources_note: The numerical model uses an infinite ideal quadrupole, not a round-rod field solution or native SIMION calculation. Frequencies are calculated; none of the figures are experimental measurements.
en.try_1: Hold the auxiliary frequency fixed and change RF frequency, rod voltage, aperture radius or ion mass above. The shared point and physical frequency readouts change; the fixed-Hz contours also move when f_RF changes.
en.try_2: Set U = 0 to make the two ideal secular frequencies equal; then apply a small nonzero U to split them. Compare their separately driven responses.
en.try_3: Increase pulse duration to narrow the response, or compare 64 with 128 integration steps. Treat changes near a stability edge or a narrow peak as a numerical-convergence question.
en.model_caption: Floquet first-zone calculation · contours are interpolated · no predicted ion loss

zh.title: 共振
zh.lead: 从 Mathieu 工作点计算离子的慢振荡频率，再观察哪些外加激励或场误差可能与之共振。共振图和响应谱随上方共享的离子及 RF 参数同步变化。
zh.fallback: 本新章节目前提供英文和中文；其他语言暂显示英文。
zh.scope: 理想线性四极场 · 两横向平面的第一公共稳定区 · 数值 Floquet 频率
zh.reference_only: 此图是四杆线性四极场的参考模型。请选用线性 RFQ 几何和四根杆后再将其解释为当前模型；更高多极场及三维 Paul 映射需要不同方程。
zh.map_note: 浅色区域表示两个横向平面均稳定。实线对应 x 运动，虚线对应 y 运动。紫色线为候选扰动条件，不是理想四极场中的损失边界。
zh.map_hint: 点击图内位置可将其 a、q 设为共享的直接工作点。这会切换为直接输入 a、q 模式，此时电压输入仅作示意。
zh.sixth: 六阶势 · 圆杆 A₆ 候选条件
zh.fourth: 四阶势 · 八极项候选条件
zh.third: 三阶势 · 对称性破缺候选条件
zh.candidate_note: 频率匹配是必要条件，而非充分条件。是否发生共振还取决于实际扰动系数、空间奇偶性、RF 谐波、激励幅度、离子振幅与观察时间。预设仅展示有代表性的最高阶频率和，不是完整的选择定则计算。理想四极场本身没有这些非线性损失线。选择消除 A₆ 的圆杆规则会在对应电场模型中消除其领先 A₆ 项；这里的候选曲线不会重新引入这一项。
zh.beta_error: 步长细化时 β 的变化
zh.drive_ratio: 外加频率 / RF 频率
zh.outside: 此点不赋予久期频率：两个平面必须都处于第一稳定带内部。边界或更高稳定带不能用折叠后的主值特征指数解释。
zh.out_of_frame: 共享工作点超出当前第一稳定区图窗。
zh.empty_lines: 部分所选频率在当前第一稳定区没有对应曲线，这是有效结果。基频偶极线要求 0 < f_ex/f_RF < 1/2，主参数共振线要求 0 < f_mod/f_RF < 1。
zh.build: 正在计算 Floquet 网格…
zh.invalid: 请检查共振参数或共享参数。
zh.fundamental_1: RF 场在一个横向方向聚焦，同时在另一个方向散焦，随后反转。稳定轨迹包含慢的久期运动以及叠加其上的 RF 周期微运动。将两个独立基本解传播一个 RF 周期，可构成单周期传播矩阵 M。
zh.fundamental_2: 对第一稳定带中的轨迹，det M = 1，特征值为 exp(±iπβ)，因此 β = arccos(tr M / 2)/π，f_sec = β f_RF / 2。主值 arccos 会把更高稳定带折叠到 0 ≤ β ≤ 1，因此本图明确限定于两个平面的第一稳定带。
zh.fundamental_3: 均匀的交变电场产生加性的驱动力，基频偶极共振满足 f_ex = f_sec。调制聚焦强度则使位置项的系数变化，主参数共振满足 f_mod = 2 f_sec。增长率和阈值依赖幅度、阻尼及持续时间，仅凭一条线不能预测离子被甩出。
zh.fundamental_4: 弱非线性项可混合不同运动频率。候选条件 pβₓ + rβᵧ = 2k 等价于 p fₓ + r fᵧ = k f_RF。只有实际电极对称性和时间依赖所允许的项才能驱动该组合。βₓ = βᵧ 等频率简并本身不会在没有耦合项时交换能量。
zh.sidebands: 完整的理想 Floquet 频谱还包含 |n ± β/2| f_RF。本图展示基频偶极与主参数共振条件，不展示全部边带或高阶共振舌。
zh.spectrum_note: 此计算实际积分两组独立的受迫 Mathieu 轨迹，分别施加 x 向和 y 向电场。每条轨迹均从 RF 零场点静止出发。图中 RMS 在整个脉冲时间内计算，是无阻尼的有限时长响应，不是稳态洛伦兹线型或损失谱。
zh.response_steps: 每 RF 周期积分步数
zh.spectrum_limit: 不包含碰撞、阻尼、非线性力、轴向束缚或孔径截断。响应超过 r₀ 时已超出实际孔径的物理解释范围。RF 与辅助余弦激励均从零相位开始。延长脉冲会使有限时长谱结构变窄；在线性模型内，弱偶极电场加倍会使位移加倍。
zh.aperture_warning: 至少一条受迫轨迹的振幅超过 r₀。这是未截断的理想方程响应，不能解释为透射或受束缚的离子。
zh.no_response: 只有两个平面均处于第一稳定带内部时，才计算响应谱。
zh.export_wait: 请等待当前计算完成后再导出。
zh.sources: 原始文献与模型适用范围
zh.sources_note: 数值模型为无限长理想四极场，不是圆杆电场解或原生 SIMION 计算。所有频率均为计算结果，图中没有实验测量数据。
zh.try_1: 保持辅助频率不变，改变上方 RF 频率、杆电压、孔径半径或离子质量。共享工作点及物理频率读数会变化；改变 f_RF 时，固定 Hz 的共振线也会移动。
zh.try_2: 令 U = 0，使两个理想久期频率相等，再施加较小的非零 U 使它们分裂，比较两种独立激励的响应。
zh.try_3: 延长脉冲以缩窄响应，或比较每周期 64 与 128 步的结果。接近稳定边界或很窄的谱峰时，应检查数值收敛。
zh.model_caption: 第一稳定区 Floquet 计算 · 等值线为插值结果 · 不预测离子损失
